method: Read-only direct-request and WebFetch audit of official visible text and official Markdown variants for the assigned apps. No shared browser was used. Hidden HTML, scripts, structured data, and search snippets were not accepted as evidence.

audit_summary.note: All 24 assigned uses were resolved with accessible official replacement evidence or complete claim reclassifications. JavaScript-only or hidden-source quotations were not retained.

actions.old_quote: API keys use HTTP Basic client side authentication. The API key acts as the username and the password is always empty.
actions.new_quote: API keys use HTTP Basic client side authentication. Basic authentication is a simple authentication scheme built into the HTTP protocol. To use it, send your HTTP requests with an Authorization header that contains the word Basic followed by a space and a base64-encoded string composed of an api key followed by a colon. The API key acts as the username and the password is always empty.
actions.review_note: The official Markdown page reproduces the full contiguous authentication paragraph. The old quotation skipped the intervening Basic-auth explanation and therefore was not an exact excerpt.

updates.summary: Notion exposes a documented REST API and a hosted remote MCP server. Its Free plan is self-serve; current Help Center guidance allows both Members and Workspace owners to add connections, subject to plan and workspace settings, and pages must be explicitly shared with the connection.
updates.blocker: Connection creation depends on plan and workspace settings, Enterprise owners can restrict member installs, and internal-connection page access must be granted manually. The hosted MCP is current, while the local open-source server is no longer actively maintained; do not build against the retiring SSE endpoint.

actions.review_note: The top-level summary and blocker repeated the superseded Free/Plus owner-only rule. These complete replacement fields align the record with the reclassified current official evidence.

actions.old_quote: Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive. Pipedrive MCP is available to customers on all Pipedrive plans.
actions.new_quote: Unlike custom API integrations or unofficial third-party connectors, Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive, requires no coding, and works with real-time CRM data. Every action performed through an AI assistant follows the user's existing permissions and is recorded in Pipedrive's change logs for full transparency and accountability. The launch reflects a broader shift in how professionals interact with software. As AI assistants become increasingly central to daily work, businesses are looking for ways to bring trusted business context into those environments without sacrificing security, reliability or control. Pipedrive MCP is available to customers on all Pipedrive plans.
actions.review_note: The current announcement separates the old sentences with additional paragraphs. The replacement quotes the full contiguous visible passage, preserving Pipedrive ownership, real-time data, permissions, and all-plans availability.
